name: Military Intelligence Service Historic Learning Center

facts.text: Building 640 housed the secret MIS language school, whose first classes began on November 1, 1941.
Set up as an interpretive center in 2013 through adaptive reuse of Building 640.

Opened by Audrey Kim to show contemporary art that raises awareness of the dangers of artificial intelligence.
A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

name: Mission Cultural Center for Latino Arts

facts.text: Founded in 1977 by artists and community activists to promote Chicano, Central American, South American and Caribbean experiences.
The building was a furniture store called The Shaft before it became the cultural center.
Offers music and arts classes, workshops and gallery exhibits.
Opened in 2010 by artists Kim Larson and Bradley Platz as a gallery of representational art.

name: National Maritime Museum

facts.text: Housed in the Aquatic Park Bathhouse, a Streamline Moderne building designed by William Mooser III.
